name: agentic-github-flow-core
description: Core skills for a pull-request workflow with Claude Code and Codex: spec-first, requirements, open-issue, repo-docs, efficient-design, ship-change and cleanup-merged.

interface.shortDescription: Core skills for a pull-request workflow with Claude Code and Codex: spec-first, requirements, open-issue, repo-docs, efficient-design, ship-change and cleanup-merged.
interface.longDescription: Specifications before large work, requirements turned into ready issues, issues an agent can pick up, a repository document layout, a checklist that keeps work growing with what changed rather than with all data, taking a task branch to a pull request with a review route, an overlap check against other unmerged work and an explicit yes before every push, and guarded cleanup of worktrees and branches after the merge.
